programs.title: Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom Protecting the Wild
programs.desc: Dr. Rae joins researchers using advanced tools in Mexico to study gray whales, wolverines and toads; meanwhile, Peter dives into the Great Barrier Reef where scientists are cultivating heat-resistant coral to help protect their fragile ecosystems.

programs.title: Earth Odyssey With Dylan Dreyer
programs.sub_title: Wildlife Wanderers: From the Alps to the Sea
programs.desc: Dylan Dreyer follows wild animal adventurers in Europe, from alpine peaks to the shores of the Tyrrhenian Sea.

programs.title: Wild Child
programs.desc: Sheinelle Jones travels on the range to meet North America's iconic animals, including American buffalo and wolves, free-flying monarch butterflies and giant elephant seals playing on the California coast.

programs.title: Forever Young With Dr. Pablo Prichard
programs.desc: Through video journals and interactions with a teenage girl with Crohn's disease, Danielle and Dr. Pablo go inside the hidden reality of chronic inflammation while exploring the tools that can calm the immune system instead of feeding the fire.

programs.title: The Aging Brain
programs.desc: Learn what's behind mental decline with age, and how to improve memory, focus and concentration with NeuroQ's Darrin Peterson and Dale Bredesen MD.
